properties.title: TanagerScene 20240925_185509_74_4001 Core Imagery
properties.description: All data products from Tanager-1 for 20240925_185509_74_4001 near Esmeralda County, Nevada, United States

basic_beta_udm.description: Usable data mask and cloud detection as a basic (georeferenced but not projected) geotiff. This information is also present in the HDF assets.

basic_radiance_hdf5.description: Top of atmosphere radiance and other associated datasets as a basic (georeferenced but not projected) HDFEOS formatted HDF5 file. Note that radiance values are stored directly as floats and no scaling/offset is needed.

basic_sr_hdf5.description: Surface reflectance and other associated datasets as a basic (geolocationed but not projected) HDFEOS formatted HDF5 file. Note that reflectance values are stored directly as floats in a 0-1 range and no scaling/offset is needed.

geolocation_array.description: WGS84 latitude/longitude pixel coordinates for basic (georeferenced but not projected) assets as a 2-band geotiff. This information is also present in the HDF assets.

ortho_beta_udm.description: Usable data mask and cloud detection as a orthorectified (georeferenced and projected) geotiff. Note that nearest neighbor resampling is used in orthorectification. The data in this file is also present in the HDF assets.

ortho_radiance_hdf5.description: Top of atmosphere radiance and other associated datasets as an orthorectified (georeferenced and projected) HDFEOS formatted HDF5 file. Note that nearest neighbor resampling is used in orthorectification and radiance values are stored directly as floats so no scaling/offset is needed.

ortho_sr_hdf5.description: Surface reflectance and other associated datasets as an orthorectified (georeferenced and projected) HDFEOS formatted HDF5 file.  Note that nearest neighbor resampling is used in orthorectification and reflectance values are stored directly as floats in a 0-1 range so no scaling/offset is needed.

ortho_visual.description: Orthorectified (georeferenced and projected) visual representation of Tanager imagery. This is essentially a geotiff version of the thumbnail asset.
